observations: Opening defines queue FIFO and stack LIFO with the same add-unseen-neighbors search.
After first step queue visited A-B with C-D-E waiting; stack A-C with B-F waiting.
Complete traversals were A-B-C-D-E-F and A-C-F-E-B-D, both visiting all six nodes.
Screenshot and reveal contrast E's discovered route: two hops through B for queue, three through C/F for stack, explaining fewest-hop property.
